tiers.starter: Enough to build a form and a simple page. Use for small apps and first drafts.
tiers.standard: Starter plus what most products need. Default tier.
tiers.complete: Standard plus specialist components. Use for a shared design system.

stateDefinitions.hover: Pointer over the control. Usually na on touch and terminal surfaces.
stateDefinitions.focus: Keyboard focus, with the visible focus ring.
stateDefinitions.loading: Waiting on work. Must not shift layout.
stateDefinitions.error: Invalid or failed, with its message.
stateDefinitions.overflow: Content longer than the space available.

components.name: Button
components.a11y: Real button role. Loading keeps its accessible name.

components.name: Icon Button
components.a11y: Needs an accessible name. Touch target at least 44 by 44 on touch.

components.name: Link
components.a11y: Distinguishable from body text without relying on colour alone.

components.name: Text Input
components.a11y: Programmatic label. Error text tied to the input.

components.name: Textarea
components.a11y: Programmatic label.

components.name: Select
components.a11y: Keyboard operable. Prefer the platform's native control unless the project has its own.

components.name: Checkbox
components.a11y: Label toggles it. Indeterminate exposed to assistive tech.

components.name: Radio Group
components.a11y: Group has a name. Arrow keys move selection on web.

components.name: Switch
components.a11y: Exposes on or off state, not only colour.

components.name: Form Field
components.a11y: Label, helper and error all programmatically linked.

components.name: Card
components.a11y: Interactive card has one clear focus target.

components.name: Badge
components.a11y: Meaning not carried by colour alone.

components.name: Alert
components.a11y: Appropriate live region when shown dynamically.

components.name: Dialog
components.a11y: Focus moves in, is trapped, returns on close. Escape closes.

components.name: Tabs
components.a11y: Tab roles and arrow-key navigation on web.

components.name: Tooltip
components.a11y: Available on focus as well as hover. Never the only source of required information.

components.name: Spinner
components.a11y: Has a status label. Respects reduced motion.

components.name: Toast
components.a11y: Live region. Does not vanish too fast to read.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.a11y: Menu roles, arrow keys, typeahead, Escape closes.

components.name: Popover
components.a11y: Focus handling matches its content. Escape closes.

components.name: Accordion
components.a11y: Trigger exposes expanded state.

components.name: Table
components.a11y: Real table semantics, header scopes, sort state exposed.

components.name: List
components.a11y: List semantics. Interactive rows reachable by keyboard.

components.name: Pagination
components.a11y: Navigation landmark. Current page exposed.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.a11y: Navigation landmark. Current page exposed.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.a11y: Landmark with a label. Skip link on web.

components.name: Side Navigation
components.a11y: Current item exposed. Collapsed items keep names.

components.name: Skeleton
components.a11y: Respects reduced motion. Busy state exposed on the region.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.a11y: Exposes value and label.

components.name: Divider
components.a11y: Decorative ones hidden from assistive tech.

components.name: Tag
components.a11y: Remove control has its own name.

components.name: Avatar
edge: image failed falls back to initials
components.a11y: Alt text or hidden when decorative.

components.name: Search Input
components.a11y: Search role. Clear button named.

components.name: Combobox
components.a11y: Combobox pattern. Hard to build correctly, so prefer an installed library.

components.name: Slider
components.a11y: Arrow keys adjust. Value and name exposed.

components.name: File Upload
components.a11y: Works without drag and drop.

components.name: Date Picker
components.a11y: Date can also be typed. Hard to build correctly, so prefer the native control or an installed library.

components.name: Empty State
components.a11y: Heading level fits the page.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.a11y: Selection exposed as a group.

components.name: Number Input
components.a11y: Spinbutton semantics. Typing allowed.

components.name: Code Input
components.a11y: One accessible name for the whole code. Autofill supported.

components.name: Tag Input
components.a11y: Added and removed tags announced.

components.name: Time Picker
components.a11y: Time can be typed.

components.name: Color Picker
components.a11y: Swatches named, value typeable.

components.name: Rating
components.a11y: Exposed as a value out of the maximum.

components.name: Calendar
components.a11y: Grid navigation by arrow keys.

components.name: Drawer
components.a11y: Same focus rules as a dialog.

components.name: Context Menu
components.a11y: Every action also reachable another way.

components.name: Command Palette
components.a11y: Combobox pattern. Results announced.

components.name: Hover Card
components.a11y: Content reachable by keyboard.

components.name: Banner
components.a11y: Landmark or live region as fits.

components.name: Stat
components.a11y: Trend not by colour alone.

components.name: Timeline
components.a11y: Ordered list semantics.

components.name: Tree View
components.a11y: Tree roles and arrow-key navigation.

components.name: Carousel
components.a11y: Pause control. No auto-advance by default.

components.name: Code Block
components.a11y: Scrollable region reachable by keyboard.

components.name: Keyboard Key
components.a11y: Readable as text.

components.name: Stepper
components.a11y: Current step exposed.

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.a11y: Current item exposed. Respects safe areas.

components.name: Floating Action Button
components.a11y: Accessible name. Does not cover content permanently.

components.name: Page Header
components.a11y: Correct heading level.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.a11y: Reachable by keyboard.
